title: Fire & Smoke Mitigation Billing Rule: Emergency Service Call and Securing Charges
content:
## The rule

> The job must be in dispatched, authorized or cleaning status when a service call or board-up line is charged. The tier is fixed at dispatch from the smoke severity, property type and affected area in each tier's entry gate. Every dispatch is charged the tier's service call fee, increased by the after-hours surcharge for an after-hours dispatch or by the holiday surcharge for a holiday dispatch, the holiday surcharge replacing the after-hours one; amounts are rounded to the cent, half up. The service call fee is not charged when the crew's recorded arrival time exceeds the arrival commitment of the job's tier. The fee is also not charged when, on the dispatch date, the customer holds a Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreement in active status whose tier carries the service call fee waiver entitlement of that charter. Emergency board-up, roof tarping and temporary fencing secure an open structure on tiers that include them and may be performed before the cleaning authorization is signed, billed at the tier's unit rates times the quantity installed.

The rule covers the two emergency charge lines of a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job: the service call line, one per dispatch, and the securing lines for board-up, roof tarp and temporary fencing.

## When the lines may be charged

| Job status | Service call line | Securing line |
|---|---|---|
| dispatched | may be charged | may be charged |
| authorized | may be charged | may be charged |
| cleaning | may be charged | may be charged |
| cleaning complete, invoiced, closed or cancelled | may not be charged | may not be charged |

The status is read from the job record at the time the line is charged.

## The service call amount

The tier whose figures apply is the job's tier, fixed at dispatch from the smoke severity, the property type and the affected area against each tier's entry gate. Each dispatch carries the rate window it fell in: business hours, after-hours or holiday.

- Business-hours dispatch: the tier's service call fee, with no surcharge.
- After-hours dispatch: the tier's service call fee increased by the tier's after-hours surcharge percentage of that fee.
- Holiday dispatch: the tier's service call fee increased by the tier's holiday surcharge percentage of that fee. The holiday surcharge replaces the after-hours surcharge; a holiday dispatch never carries both.

The result is rounded to the cent, half up.

### Worked figures (hypothetical fee)

Take a hypothetical service call fee of 210.10 and surcharges of 35 percent after-hours and 60 percent holiday:

| Rate window | Working | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| business hours | 210.10 with no surcharge | 210.10 |
| after-hours | 210.10 increased by 35 percent of 210.10, which is 283.635, rounded half up | 283.64 |
| holiday | 210.10 increased by 60 percent of 210.10 (the after-hours surcharge not added) | 336.16 |

## When the service call fee is not charged

Every dispatch is charged the fee unless one of the two stated conditions holds; either one alone is enough.

| Recorded arrival later than the tier's commitment | Active qualifying service agreement on the dispatch date | Service call fee |
|---|---|---|
| no | no | charged |
| yes | no | not charged |
| no | yes | not charged |
| yes | yes | not charged |

Late arrival. The comparison is between the crew's recorded arrival time, in minutes from the booked call, and the arrival commitment of the job's tier. The fee is not charged only when the recorded arrival exceeds the commitment. On a hypothetical job whose tier commitment is 120 minutes, a recorded arrival of 120 minutes does not exceed the commitment, while a recorded arrival of 121 minutes does.

Service agreement. The test date is the dispatch date. The customer must, on that date, hold a Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreement in active status whose tier carries the service call fee waiver entitlement of that charter.

## Securing lines

Emergency board-up, roof tarping and temporary fencing secure an open structure. They are billed only on tiers that include them, and they may be performed before the customer signs the cleaning authorization. Each securing line is the tier's unit rate for that item (per plywood sheet, per square foot of tarp, per linear foot of fencing) times the quantity installed, rounded to the cent, half up.

Hypothetical line: 7.5 hypothetical square feet of tarp at a hypothetical unit rate of 1.37 is 10.275, which rounds half up to 10.28.

## Basis questions

Does a dispatch booked before any cleaning authorization carry a service call line? Yes, if the job is in dispatched status; dispatched is one of the three statuses in which the line may be charged.

Can a board-up line be charged once the job reaches cleaning complete? No; securing lines, like service call lines, may be charged only in dispatched, authorized or cleaning status.
